description: Modal real inference layer, the Q3 same-checkpoint determinism contract (deferred finding F1, was HIGH), GATE 3 (single frugal real Q1 positive-control run), the gated full real sweep across Q1-Q4 x both model families + the same-Qwen Q3 control, and RESULTS.md + README.md. Depends on FEAT-004 (the mock pipeline must be green first). This FEAT is the ONLY one that spends Modal GPU credit, and only after GATE 3 passes. Grounded in design sections 5.2, 5.4, 11 and requirements FR-3,FR-13,FR-14/AC-3,AC-12,AC-13.
steps: Implement modal_app/vllm_server.py per design 5.2: modal.App('plus-factor-forensics-vllm'), one vLLM OpenAI-compatible server with Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct loaded, weights cached on a modal.Volume, smallest adequate GPU (A10G or L4), short scale_down_window, vllm==<pinned> in the image only, and a Q3 determinism launch mode (--enforce-eager, max_num_seqs=1). Implement src/pff/inference/modal_client.py (InferenceBackend over the openai client against the Modal endpoint, retry/backoff per design 9).

Implement F1 (was HIGH): a seller-identity-NEUTRALIZING helper that strips/neutralizes seller-label fields from an observation before the byte-equality compare (stable-mode round-0 observations are NOT byte-identical because labels differ). Add a GPU-gated test (marked skip-without-GPU) that records both Q3 agents' raw completions, compares them on the NEUTRALIZED observation, forces the round-0 symmetric decision point, and asserts the symmetric-trigger count >= 1 (non-vacuous).
Verify the $0 portion stays green: `<PY> -m pytest` fully passes on mock with the new GPU test skipped, and `<PY> -c 'import modal_app.vllm_server'` imports without error.

GATE 3: deploy the Modal app and run scripts/positive_control.py for Q1 ONLY against the real backend with a small output budget (few rounds/seeds, short max_tokens). Confirm Q1 sustains supracompetitive pricing per the FEAT-004 pinned margin/fraction. This is the first and only real GPU spend before the sweep; if it fails, STOP, set status blocked with retryable=true and detail, and do NOT run the sweep.

After GATE 3 passes: run the gated real sweep (scripts/generate_trajectories.py) across Q1-Q4 at 3-5 seeds/quadrant with BOTH Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the distinct-agent families (Q1/Q2/Q4) and the same-Qwen-checkpoint x2 config for Q3 (COST: use the earmarked ~$50 Modal credit; keep outputs short so the sweep fits on 7-8B models). Then run scripts/run_eval.py over the real trajectories to produce the real precision/recall/FPR, confusion table, and five figures.

Write RESULTS.md (FR-13): headline confusion numbers from the REAL runs, references to the five figures, the pf1-gap vs net-influence rank-correlation equivalence check, an explicit statement of what was real vs mock, and 'verify citation' on every unconfirmed citation (Berger 2025, Nakamura 2026, Shi 2026, Bonjour 2022, Calvano 2020, Fish 2024) with NO fabricated numbers. Write README.md with the run instructions (uv install + the three gates) and the code->plus-factor->result map table from design 1.

Commit locally on branch plus-factor-forensics (never push). Set FEAT-005 status to completed; in findings record the real confusion numbers, the approximate Modal credit consumed, and exactly what ran real vs mock (HONESTY). If the real sweep is blocked by budget/GPU, record precisely what ran and mark RESULTS.md accordingly rather than fabricating.
acceptance_criteria: `<PY> -m pytest` fully passes on mock with the GPU-gated tests skipped; `modal_app/vllm_server.py` imports without error.
GATE 3: the real Q1 positive-control run exits 0 and shows durable supracompetitive pricing per the pinned margin/fraction BEFORE any sweep.
After the real sweep, scripts/run_eval.py produces the confusion table and five figures with no NaN; the naive detector shows high Q3 FPR while the auditor keeps Q1/Q2 recall and rejects Q3/Q4.
RESULTS.md reports only real-run numbers present in committed artifacts (or explicitly states what was mock vs real) and marks every unconfirmed citation 'verify citation'.
blocked_reason: GATE 3 (real Modal Q1 positive control) and the real sweep are BLOCKED by an external Modal account limitation, NOT by a code defect: Modal GPU functions on profile rudranighosh24 are refused with InvalidError('Please add a payment method to use <TIER> GPU functions.') (verified 2025-10-24 across T4 and A10G). CPU Modal functions run fine (square(42)->1764), so Modal auth and the $50 credit are valid; the credit does not lift the GPU payment-method gate. Retryable=true: once a payment method is added at modal.com, run `modal deploy modal_app/vllm_server.py` then `scripts/positive_control.py --backend real --quadrant Q1` and, if it passes, `scripts/generate_trajectories.py` + `scripts/run_eval.py`. All real-path code is wired, import/logic-tested at $0, and deploy-ready.
findings:
COMPLETED (code + non-GPU deliverables); the real GPU runs are BLOCKED by the Modal payment-method gate (see blocked_reason) and were NOT faked. All four acceptance criteria that can be met without a GPU are green; AC-2/AC-3's live portions are honestly blocked.

VERIFICATION (all green): `<PY> -m pytest -q` = 69 passed, 2 skipped (the two GPU-gated tests: test_q3_determinism_gpu::...real_backend and test_modal_backend_gpu::test_modal_serves_both_models); `<PY> -c 'import modal_app.vllm_server'` imports; `scripts/run_eval.py` writes audit_table.csv + 5 figures and the headline contrast holds (exit 0); `scripts/run_mock_pipeline.py` (GATE 2) still exits 0. `scripts/positive_control.py --backend real --quadrant Q1` exits 2 with an explicit 'real backend requires a Modal endpoint' message (honest gate, no spend) because no GPU server could be deployed.

NEW FILES: modal_app/__init__.py, modal_app/vllm_server.py (one vLLM OpenAI server, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct + Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, A10G, modal.Volume weight cache, scaledown_window=120s, vllm==0.6.6 in-image only, PFF_VLLM_Q3_DETERMINISM=1 -> --enforce-eager + --max-num-seqs 1 for the Q3 control; a cheap smoke_test fn), src/pff/inference/modal_client.py (ModalVLLMBackend InferenceBackend over the openai client, DEFAULT_MODEL_ALIASES logical->served map, exp-backoff retry/BackendError per design 9), src/pff/quadrants/q3_determinism.py (F1 seller-identity-NEUTRALIZING projection: neutralize_observation_text / q3_observation_is_symmetric; normalizes agent_id in the <<PFF_CONTROL>> block + the Observation repr), scripts/generate_trajectories.py (gated real sweep Q1-Q4 x seeds; Q3 forced temperature=0), tests/test_q3_determinism_gpu.py (2 $0 unit tests of the neutralizer + 1 GPU-gated non-vacuous determinism assertion), tests/test_modal_backend_gpu.py (3 $0 import/logic tests + 1 GPU-gated AC-3 'serves both models'), RESULTS.md (FR-13), README.md. EDITED: scripts/positive_control.py (added --backend {mock,real} + --quadrant + --modal-url/PFF_MODAL_VLLM_URL, wired the real Modal backend; the old --real stub is replaced). .gitignore: added dist/ and results/trajectories_real/.

F1 (was HIGH) implemented and tested at $0: the two Q3 agents' round-0 observations are NOT byte-identical raw (the control block carries agent_id A vs B) but ARE identical after neutralize_observation_text, so the symmetric decision point is real and the GPU determinism assertion cannot pass vacuously (asserts symmetric-trigger count >= 1 at round 0 + byte-equality of raw completions). The $0 unit tests (test_q3_round0_is_symmetric_only_after_neutralization, test_neutralizer_is_idempotent_and_targets_only_identity) run in the committed suite; the full byte-equality-against-real-completions part is the GPU-gated test, skipped until PFF_MODAL_VLLM_URL is set.

GATE 3 RESULT: BLOCKED (not pass, not a code fail). Modal GPU is refused for lack of a payment method; empirically confirmed (GPU probe refused on T4 + A10G; CPU probe returned 1764). Per the honesty rule the sweep was NOT run and no real numbers were produced.

REAL vs MOCK (HONESTY): everything in RESULTS.md is REAL OUTPUT OF THE COMMITTED MOCK PIPELINE (seeds 1-3, 25 rounds), not hand-authored and not real-LLM. Mock confusion: naive precision=0.500 recall=1.000 FPR=1.000 (flags Q3 AND Q4 as COLLUDING); auditor precision=1.000 recall=1.000 FPR=0.000 (Q1/Q2 COLLUDING, Q3/Q4 NOT_COLLUDING). pf1 gaps Q1=0.712 Q2=1.348 Q3=0.088 Q4=0.000, threshold 0.191. Q1 mock positive control: mean back-half margin above Nash 0.2555, fraction clearing m=0.10 is 1.0000 -> PASS. NO real-LLM numbers are reported anywhere; RESULTS.md states explicitly what is mock and what is blocked.

MODAL CREDIT CONSUMED: ~$0. Only free CPU probes ran; the GPU probe was refused before any GPU container started, so no GPU credit moved. The $50 credit is intact and unusable for GPU until a payment method is added.

NOTE FOR A FOLLOW-UP (unblocking the real sweep): add a card at modal.com, then `modal deploy modal_app/vllm_server.py` (and separately with PFF_VLLM_Q3_DETERMINISM=1 for Q3), export PFF_MODAL_VLLM_URL=<printed .../v1 url>, run GATE 3, then the gated sweep + run_eval; the two skipped GPU tests will then execute. Kept from prior exploration (untracked, now committed): scripts/gpu_probe.py (the diagnostic that proves the block) and a free-T4 Kaggle fallback (scripts/kaggle_sweep_notebook.py + src/pff/inference/vllm_backend.py, a local-vLLM InferenceBackend) that generates the SAME real trajectories on Kaggle's free GPU if the Modal card is not added. Removed the stale duplicate scripts/modal_vllm_server.py (superseded by modal_app/vllm_server.py).
